Requires audio/video of engine running; none provided.
No odometer or mileage document visible.

risks.proof: Video clip of engine starting and idling, plus compression test photo/reading

risks.risk: Mileage and age cannot be confirmed, affecting wear expectations
risks.proof: Photo of odometer or Belgian deregistration/import document showing mileage

risks.risk: Exact model/fitment unclear, so compatibility with buyer's car is unverified
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine ID plate or casting number
risks.if_unproven: priced generically as unverified-fitment used engine

risks.risk: Wiring harness or sensors may be missing or damaged, raising repair cost
risks.proof: Close-up photos of harness connectors and sensor completeness

risks.risk: Possible mixing of two different engines in one listing, causing confusion over what is actually sold
risks.proof: Separate clear photos of each engine with its own ID plate
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value of the two visible engines until clarified

proof_requests: Video of the engine(s) starting and running with audible sound
Clear photo of engine ID plate or casting/model number
Photo of Belgian import/deregistration paperwork or mileage document
Close-up of wiring harness and sensor connectors to confirm completeness
Confirmation of which single engine is actually for sale if two are shown
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new photo or video does not change the evidence; the claims remain unverified and the item must still be priced at worst case as an untested, possibly non-running engine.
